description: Decru'sStorage Encryption Processor (SEP) is the primary cryptographic and keymanagement engine for Decru DataFort products. Decru DataFort is awire-speed storage security appliance. DataFort uses hardware-basedencryption, authentication, secure access controls, and secure logging toprotect networked storage in NAS, SAN, DAS, and Tape environments. DataFortcan be deployed transparently, with no changes to desktops, servers,applications, or user workflow.
